text: Use OpenAlex field (not domain or subfield) of each work's primary topic, counting each distinct snapshot work at most once. Define largest as the 10 fields with most works across publication years 2021–2024, fixed across years. Include all work types and report any works without an assignable primary field separately.

Use all distinct works.work_id in the pre-scoped Columbia I78577930 lineage snapshot for publication_year 2021–2024 inclusive, with all work types and no additional affiliation filters. Assign each work only via authoritative works.primary_topic_id → topics.topic_id → topics.field_id/field; no fallback to scored topics. Keep missing assignments as NULL field_id / 'Unassigned' with is_unassigned=true, and zero-fill all 26 taxonomy fields in every year. Defer ranking to the analyst: exclude Unassigned, rank on pooled 2021–2024 count, and hold that top-10 cohort fixed across years.

Use Columbia University OpenAlex institution I78577930 and snapshot-defined children, distinct works of all types assigned to primary-topic field only. Fix the top 10 by descending 2021–2024 total among assigned fields, breaking ties by ascending numeric OpenAlex field ID; use this same cohort for every year. Top-10 share uses all snapshot works including Unassigned as denominator. YoY percentages and endpoint percentages use actual prior-year and 2021 counts respectively; index sets 2021 to 100. Rising/falling classification uses endpoint count change.
